title: Bound paid carrier loans for owned lifts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Three fixed-itinerary carrier-loan scopes exhaust all 47 owned MOVE anchors in the exact word. The only earlier same-endpoint carrier is f988 at 36647 for h1540 at 45647. The read at 36648 blocks deferred restoration. For immediate restoration, the exact covector x397 − x382 − 3(x2+x230)/2 annihilates all 17 live chart-1091 donors and evaluates to −2 on the required carrier row. The ideal price of this one deletion is 17 raw units.

The only strict nested carrier is f1161 at 40226 for h1550 at 44235, using charts 541→543→127. Input 4 has coefficient −1/2 in the carrier row and zero in both donors, roles 628 and 630. The reverse scan also sees four descending-anchor incidences, all rejected by strict nesting. The compatible directed gross upper after geometry is 16.91416786145965 raw. The verified saving is zero and no scoped key remains unresolved.

## Task and overlap

Use exact [#7334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7334) at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` and signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7244) studies role 988 at a distinct cut. [#7387](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7387) and [#7389](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7389) establish the owner anchors and scope different zero or reconstruction edits. This package contributes exact chronology and rowspace obstructions for dirty carrier restoration. The package is the only new commit, stacked on the two existing [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI commits.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-paid-carrier-loan-bound/replay.py
```

Clean replay authenticates dependencies and reproduces twelve price, geometry and support receipts. Independent sparse reverse rows confirm both separations. Three altered-input controls reject. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, six navigation tests and Git-free export replay passed locally. No replacement multiplier was built after the necessary gates failed.

## Credit

#7334 and #7113 supply the literal word and caller, #7338 the independent admission, #7387 the owned contact census, #7389 the deletion prices, #7362 and #7298 the signed invoice and directed tariff, and #7355 and #7384 the forward row and span engines. #7165 and #7308 supply prior unchanged-donor recovery and #7244 supplies prior chart-1091 carrier work. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Changed donor itineraries, multi-carrier recovery and intermediate owned work between the two original clocks are outside the exclusion. Price any newly charged work before testing an expanded scope.
